content:
The Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 Programming Jig is a single-head provisioning system designed to easily flash an OS to the Raspberry Pi CM5 without a carrier board. The jig connects to the provisioning network via Ethernet or Wi-Fi and also features a second Ethernet port for the Compute Module. The CM5 is kept in place by a mechanical clamping mechanism, and the jig relies on pogo pins to interface with the Compute Module. Specifications: Features Provisioning head Pogo pin interface Mechanical clamping mechanism Compatible with Raspberry Pi Compute Module 5 Connectivity JIG ETH – Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 jack for connecting the jig to the network; note DUT ETH – Gigabit Ethernet RJ45 jack for connecting the CM5 to the network WiFi with external antenna, as an alternative to JIG ETH USB-C boot connector to connect to the host Misc – LED status indicators Power – 12V/2A (24W) DC via power [...]
